scrapeNotes: Extremely experimental-processing-forward catalog (Ratnagiri Estate microlots dominate: culture process, carbonic maceration, thermal shock, nitrogen maceration, etc. each with Brix/fermentation-hour detail). Nearly the entire catalog (all but a couple of newly-restocked items) was sold out at scrape time. Product pages list one price across all grind-size selector options for a given weight — recorded once per product rather than duplicated per grind option.
